word.meaning: through it; as a result, thereby
word.shortDefinition: Through it; as a result, thereby.

sampleSentences.german: Er hat viel geübt und dadurch gewonnen.
sampleSentences.english: He practised a lot and won as a result.

sampleSentences.german: Dadurch, dass es regnete, kamen wir zu spät.
sampleSentences.english: Because it rained, we were late.

sampleSentences.german: Siehst du die Tür? Geh dadurch.
sampleSentences.english: See the door? Go through it.

memoryHook: Da + durch = as a result; dadurch, dass … = by …-ing.
